where: Duskapple Orchard — Tinderwick's old orchard through the west hedge, from the first visit until the first Gleam is relit (the fallen-star crater)
mood: The Fallen Star — the hometown lullaby gone cold in C minor, slowed to half time among charred boughs; a distant bell for the strike, and a cinder that still glows.
_note: Classic twin: assets/audio/midi/specs/duskapple-orchard.json (90 BPM, 4/4, C minor, half-time Vesper motif, 16 bars AABA, bridge glimmer in Ab/Eb). Motif medium pins ~90 BPM; the half-time feel rides on top.

90 BPM with a slow half-time feel
C minor, the hometown lullaby turned dark

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {one distant low bell tolls and rings into the cold air, a glassy celesta answers with a slow falling figure, and the muted lead begins the darkened theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hometown lullaby in C minor at half time: a slow rising lift that hangs, then a sighing minor settle home; long notes over cold celesta, clear and hummable}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again, low strings drawn softly underneath, the bell tolling once at the phrase start, glass harmonica shimmering in the gaps}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a faint warm glimmer, the harmony turns to A-flat and E-flat major, a soft plucked harp glows like an ember and the lead lifts to its highest note}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the glow sinks back into C minor and the darkened lullaby returns, calm and sad; the last bar leans on the dominant straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
